name: XGIMI Horizon S Pro
summary: Tidy an XGIMI Horizon S Pro by turning off its burn-in tools, store demo, bug reporter and streaming apps. Free phone app with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The XGIMI Horizon S Pro projector comes with a store demo, factory burn-in and Wi-Fi check tools that run at boot, a bug report uploader, Google feedback and recommendation rows, a file manager, a music app and an animated screensaver. A projector at home has no use for most of them.

This list was tested on a real unit, and the result was checked again after a restart. The projector's keystone, focus, autofocus, remote and Bluetooth services are not on the list at all, and the HDMI 1 input is kept. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never uninstalls anything.
keep: Keystone, focus and autofocus services, which the projector needs
The remote keys, brightness and core XGIMI system services
The first-boot setup wizard, kept on purpose
notes: Only HDMI 1 shows as an input on this projector, so the other input labels will not appear.
The default screensaver is off in this list. Choose another screensaver in the TV's settings, or the projector has nothing to show while idle.

faq.q: Will the HDMI input still work?
faq.a: Yes. HDMI 1 is kept along with its player and input service. It is the only input this projector shows.
Chromecast built-in is off by choice in this list, so turn it back on in the app if you cast to this projector.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off Google's recommendation rows and the Backdrop screensaver, along with several streaming apps. Other parts of the home screen are not on this list.
